rulings.subject: GOAL.md s1b research-focus test scope call: statements-only vs statements+constitutive-instruments (flagged awaiting operator ratification; under statements-only K1/K2/K4 grade as instruments)
rulings.first_principles: The operator's north-star sentence (desktop note 2026-06-25, surfaced 2026-07-03) IS an instrument: 'discover the computation primitive that could lower the barrier to foundation model creation' - the candidate primitive is the verified-experience gate itself. A statements-only reading would rule the goal's own north star out of research scope. Inclusive reading kept, with the guard that instrument-contributions still owe the leg-C falsifiable field-delta bar - 'we built a tool' papers still fail.
rulings.rider: K1/K2/K4 remain gradable as research contributions; each still needs its dated-negative delta receipted.
